generator_requirement: Use the same approved GPT_nogeneral image workflow as the previous 80 FL portfolio boards. If that exact preset is unavailable, do not substitute another renderer; keep these prompts as the handoff specification.

cases.title: FLOW BRIDGE
cases.palette: deep navy, electric violet, coral accent, ice blue
cases.visual_direction: Omnichannel integration control center with a strong left-to-right journey and event flow.
hero_elements: Instagram Direct inbox with referral source
cases.prompt: Create one premium 16:9 landscape portfolio case-study board, target 1672x941 px, matching a polished FL.ru/Behance SaaS presentation. Show a coherent product UI across 3 to 5 large readable panels with realistic Russian interface labels, crisp typography, careful grid, subtle depth, no stock photos, no real client logos, no fake testimonials, no budgets and no performance claims. The title and the visible label «ДЕМО-КЕЙС» must be clean and correctly spelled. Use only short interface text to reduce glyph errors. Do not create a generic wireframe, phone-only collage, isometric 3D scene, illegible microtext or random charts. Product: FLOW BRIDGE, a demo omnichannel funnel orchestrator. Visual direction: deep navy and electric violet control center with coral status accents. Compose a strong left-to-right flow Instagram Direct → Telegram bot → GetCourse → payment, connected by one glowing event spine. Include one desktop control dashboard, one Telegram phone mockup, one user journey card, and a compact integration health panel. Visible Russian labels may include «Путь пользователя», «Источник», «Регистрация», «Оплата», «События». Put «FLOW BRIDGE» and «ДЕМО-КЕЙС» prominently.
